mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.role_id = r.id) as user_count FROM role r ORDER BY r.id
SELECT id, code, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at FROM role WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM role r INNER JOIN user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (code, name, description, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status})
INSERT IGNORE INTO user_role (user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO role_permission (role_id, permission_id) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionId})
mapper.select: SELECT permission_id FROM role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT user_id FROM user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
